		AND typeof("shared_listing_stage"."cleanup_generation") = 'integer' AND "shared_listing_stage"."cleanup_generation" BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991

		OR ("shared_listing_stage"."cleanup_generation" > 0 AND "shared_listing_stage"."cleanup_owner" IS NOT NULL AND "shared_listing_stage"."state" = 'retired')

shared_listing_task_outcome_generation_c.name: shared_listing_task_outcome_generation_check
shared_listing_task_outcome_generation_c.value:
typeof("shared_listing_task_outcome"."job_generation") = 'integer' AND "shared_listing_task_outcome"."job_generation" BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991
 AND typeof("shared_listing_task_outcome"."task_generation") = 'integer' AND "shared_listing_task_outcome"."task_generation" BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991
 AND ("shared_listing_task_outcome"."computation_generation" IS NULL OR (typeof("shared_listing_task_outcome"."computation_generation") = 'integer' AND "shared_listing_task_outcome"."computation_generation" BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991))
 AND ("shared_listing_task_outcome"."incarnation" IS NULL OR (typeof("shared_listing_task_outcome"."incarnation") = 'integer' AND "shared_listing_task_outcome"."incarnation" BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991))

shared_listing_task_outcome_fact_check.name: shared_listing_task_outcome_fact_check
shared_listing_task_outcome_fact_check.value:
"shared_listing_task_outcome"."fact" IS NULL OR coalesce(json_valid("shared_listing_task_outcome"."fact")
 AND json_extract("shared_listing_task_outcome"."fact", '$.narHash') = json_extract("shared_listing_task_outcome"."claim", '$.narHash')
 AND json_extract("shared_listing_task_outcome"."fact", '$.generatorRevision') = json_extract("shared_listing_task_outcome"."claim", '$.generatorRevision')
 AND json_extract("shared_listing_task_outcome"."fact", '$.format') = 1
 AND json_type("shared_listing_task_outcome"."fact", '$.size') = 'integer' AND json_extract("shared_listing_task_outcome"."fact", '$.size') BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991
 AND length(json_extract("shared_listing_task_outcome"."fact", '$.digest')) = 64 AND json_extract("shared_listing_task_outcome"."fact", '$.digest') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*', 0)

shared_listing_task_outcome_kind_check.name: shared_listing_task_outcome_kind_check
shared_listing_task_outcome_kind_check.value:
coalesce(("shared_listing_task_outcome"."kind" = 'generated' AND "shared_listing_task_outcome"."fact" IS NOT NULL AND "shared_listing_task_outcome"."incarnation" IS NOT NULL AND "shared_listing_task_outcome"."reference_epoch" IS NOT NULL AND "shared_listing_task_outcome"."computation_generation" IS NOT NULL AND "shared_listing_task_outcome"."stage_id" IS NOT NULL AND "shared_listing_task_outcome"."reason" IS NULL)
 OR ("shared_listing_task_outcome"."kind" = 'reused' AND "shared_listing_task_outcome"."fact" IS NOT NULL AND "shared_listing_task_outcome"."incarnation" IS NOT NULL AND "shared_listing_task_outcome"."reference_epoch" IS NOT NULL AND "shared_listing_task_outcome"."stage_id" IS NULL AND "shared_listing_task_outcome"."reason" IS NULL)
 OR ("shared_listing_task_outcome"."kind" IN ('skipped','failed') AND "shared_listing_task_outcome"."fact" IS NULL AND "shared_listing_task_outcome"."incarnation" IS NULL AND "shared_listing_task_outcome"."reference_epoch" IS NULL AND "shared_listing_task_outcome"."computation_generation" IS NULL AND "shared_listing_task_outcome"."stage_id" IS NULL AND "shared_listing_task_outcome"."reason" IN ('source-unavailable','source-mismatch','unsupported-source','unsupported-generator-revision','resource-limit','generation-failed')), 0)

tenant_cache_read_credential_identity_ch.name: tenant_cache_read_credential_identity_check
tenant_cache_read_credential_identity_ch.value: ("tenant_cache_read_credential"."cache_kind" = 'default' AND "tenant_cache_read_credential"."cache_name" IS NULL) OR ("tenant_cache_read_credential"."cache_kind" = 'named' AND "tenant_cache_read_credential"."cache_name" IS NOT NULL)

attestation_ref.name: attestation_ref
attestation_ref.definition:
select "tenant", "cache_kind", "cache_name", "store_path_hash", "generation", "predicate_type", "digest", "readable" from "attestation_ref_storage" where "attestation_ref_storage"."readable" = true AND EXISTS (
		SELECT 1 FROM "blob_ref"
		WHERE "blob_ref"."tenant" = "attestation_ref_storage"."tenant"
		 AND "blob_ref"."cache_kind" = "attestation_ref_storage"."cache_kind"
		 AND "blob_ref"."cache_name" IS "attestation_ref_storage"."cache_name"
		 AND "blob_ref"."store_path_hash" = "attestation_ref_storage"."store_path_hash"
		 AND "blob_ref"."generation" = "attestation_ref_storage"."generation"
	)

blob_ref.name: blob_ref
blob_ref.definition:
select "tenant", "cache_kind", "cache_name", "store_path_hash", "generation", "nar_hash", "readable", "cache_generation" from "blob_ref_storage" where "blob_ref_storage"."readable" = true AND NOT EXISTS (
		SELECT 1 FROM path_read_revocation AS fence
		WHERE fence.tenant = "blob_ref_storage"."tenant"
		 AND fence.cache_kind = "blob_ref_storage"."cache_kind"
		 AND fence.cache_name IS "blob_ref_storage"."cache_name"
		 AND fence.store_path_hash = "blob_ref_storage"."store_path_hash"
		 AND fence.cache_generation = "blob_ref_storage"."cache_generation"
		 AND fence.generation >= "blob_ref_storage"."generation"
	)
